text:
alex_ops: Heads up — prod alert from pagerhook: incident-bot ACKs are not being received for multiple routes. PagerHook logs show async write failures and queue growth. Possible missed pages to oncall :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Automated: received webhook id=pf-9876 from pagerhook, attempted delivery to oncall sam_oncall — no ACK observed. (delivery_attempts=3)

sam_oncall: I haven't gotten anything (no SMS / phone). watching monitors now.

jay_infra: checking pagerhook logs — seeing 502/503 on POST /v1/ack and upstream timeouts. queue depth trending up.

morgan_support: FYI we've had two inbound tickets from customers saying they didn't get pages 14:00-14:05 UTC. tagging here.

alex_ops: ok manual mitigation — I'll trigger manual page to oncall. @sam_oncall confirm when you get it.

sam_oncall: got manual page and ACKed. thanks.

jay_infra: quick log snippet reproducer:
```
[2026-03-17T14:01:12Z] ERROR pagerhook write ack id=pf-9876 upstream_timeout
[2026-03-17T14:01:13Z] WARN queue_depth=423 conn_pool_exhausted=true
[2026-03-17T14:02:01Z] INFO backpressure applied to inbound webhooks
```

priya_sre: is the PD->incident-bot flow only using pagerhook? If so, we should switch to direct routing until pagerhook is healthy. I'll prepare a config patch.

alex_ops: runbook link: <https://runbook.internal/pagerhook-ack-fail> — follow emergency reroute steps and note customer impact.

jay_infra: pushed emergency override to edge gateway (preview):
```diff
- route: pd -> pagerhook
+ route: pd -> incident-bot-direct (fallback)
```

incident-bot: Notice: routing fallback applied — PD routes now going to incident-bot-direct. Monitoring delivery and ACK rates. :eyes:

morgan_support: please collect list of affected customers and times so CS can reach out proactively.

sam_oncall: I'll draft a proactive customer note for CS and paste here for approval.

alex_ops: likely root cause: pagerhook DB connection pool exhaustion after a spike. Priya — can you scale workers and restart?

priya_sre: scaling and rolling restart in progress: `kubectl scale deploy/pagerhook --replicas=5` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/pagerhook`. Will report when pods healthy.

jay_infra: after scale+restart, success rate for ack writes improved to ~99%. queue draining, backlog down to ~12.

alex_ops: good. keep fallback in place for 30m and then revert if stable. create an incident ticket/postmortem and mark P1? I'll start notes.

sam_oncall: confirmed no missed pages in last 10m. closing live mitigation for now.

morgan_support: logged affected accounts to incident ticket: ACCT-1234, ACCT-5678; ETA for outreach: 30m.

incident-bot: Automated: mitigation actions recorded in incident ticket INC-2026-0317-01.

alex_ops: Thanks all — follow-up items: postmortem, add auto-scaling margin for pagerhook, improve health-checks to fail fast before queueing.

sam_oncall: +1 — will add to oncall retro notes.
